scope_note: Covers the duties and functions the Victims and Witnesses (Scotland) Act 2014 confers on the Lord Advocate, prosecutors and procurators fiscal. Limited to that Act and to legislation; case law and Crown Office policy are out of scope.

steps.title: Retrieve the overarching duties
steps.detail: Find the general principles the Lord Advocate must have regard to, and the duty to set and publish standards of service.

steps.title: Retrieve the victims' rights duties
steps.detail: Find the sections conferring duties to provide the Victims' Code, refer to support services, aid understanding, and provide interpretation and translation.

steps.title: Retrieve the prosecution-specific duties
steps.detail: Find the duty to make rules for reviewing a decision not to prosecute and the duty to disclose information about criminal proceedings.

steps.title: Establish how procurators fiscal are caught
steps.detail: Retrieve the interpretation provision to establish whether procurators fiscal are bound directly, through the definition of prosecutor, or by a deeming provision.
